To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a PMMA–LiBOb gel electrolyte has been developed for lithium ion battery application, and it has been demonstrated that this electrolyte can be used in a Li/Lico2 cell with stable capacity.
we have developed a novel gel electrolyte based on LiBOB, EC and PC with 10–20 wt.% of PMMA.
the LiBOB containing gel electrolyte with 20 % PMMA is a promising electrolyte for lithium batteries, which shows good thermal and electrochemical stability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a new LiBOB containing gel polymer electrolyte, its characterization and its application as an electrolyte for Li/LiCo02 cells.
the synthesis of PMMA–LiBOG GPE for application in lithium battery.
the development of PMMA–LiBOb based gel polymer electrolytes for Li ion batteries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a LiBOB based GPE is an excellent candidate for lithium ion battery applications.
LiBOB based GPEs have the potential to be used as electrolyte in lithium ion battery.
the LiBOB containing PMMA based GPE is a promising electrolyte candidate for lithium ion batteries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LiBOB–EC–PC–PMMA gel polymer electrolyte shows good thermal, electrochemical and mechanical stability, which can be used as an electrolytic membrane in lithium batteries.
the GPE with LiBOB as the salt and PMMA as the polymer matrix shows good electrochemical properties and can be used as an electrolytic separator in lithium ion battery applications.
the GPE with LiBOB based electrolyte has good electrochemical stability and high ionic conductivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GPEs prepared in this work are promising electrolyte for lithium ion batteries.
the Li/LiCo02 cell with the 20 % PMMA containing GPM electrolyte shows a stable discharge capacity of ~ 130 mAh g− .
LiBOB based GPEs are promising candidates for application in lithium batteries.
